subject: general
question: Which minister introduced the Essential Defence Services Bill in Lok Sabha on 22 July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajnath Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Lok Sabha** passed **the Essential Defence Services Bill, 2021 on 3 August 2021.
 
• The bill seeks to replace the ordinance promulgated in June 2021 and allows the central government to prohibit strikes, lock-outs, and lay-offs in units engaged in essential defense services.
 
• The prohibition order will remain in force for six months and may be extended by another six months.​__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Key features of the Bill include:

 
 
• Essential defence services:

 
 
• Essential defence services include any service in: (i) any establishment or undertaking dealing with the production of goods or equipment required for defence-related purposes, or (ii) any establishment of the armed forces or connected with them or defence.
 
 
 
• Public utility service: The Bill amends the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 to include essential defence services under public utility services.
 
• Strikes: Under the Bill, the strike is defined as cessation of work by a body of persons acting together. 
 
• Prohibition on strikes, lock-outs, and lay-offs: Under the Bill, the central government may prohibit strikes, lock-outs, and lay-offs in units engaged in essential defence services.
